_comment: Per-pack ΔE / SSIM budgets for envato packs marked stage="gated" in
A gated pack passes iff every page with a matching reference satisfies:
mean_de <= max_mean_de  AND  p99_de <= max_p99_de  AND  ssim >= min_ssim.
Calibration: start from the worst-page metrics emitted in
reports/<pack>/report.json after a clean run, add ~20% headroom, and
tighten over time. Never *loosen* a threshold to mask a regression — fix
Adding a pack to this list requires its manifest entry's `stage` field
to also flip to "gated". Without that flip, test.sh will not call out
to this file for the pack.
